mostWorthwhile.text: Building the hair-cell and membrane assembly was most worthwhile: the planned inset of bending bundles, followed by the explanation of fluid movement changing nerve signals, made the mechanical-to-neural connection clearer.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the completed ears to the hearing pathways felt less informative: the planned schematic shows nerves reaching brain pathways but gives little detail about those pathways.

surprise.text: The relative motion between cochlear membranes bends hair-cell bundles; I had been uncertain about their precise arrangement.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, though several were the only offered gameplay action and primarily joined already-built parts. The term cochlea also appeared without an explicit definition, although the chamber description helped establish its location.

continue.text: I would be mildly interested in another chapter if it offered similarly clear physical mechanisms, but the several predictable connection steps made this chapter less compelling as a game.
